Every surface is paper

The living reference for Bauhouse's design system. Its tokens are the app's own (copied from frontend/src/styles.css by pnpm design:sync), and every pattern here is a component in frontend/src/components/ui/. Before adding a value or a component, find it here; if it isn't here, add it to the system first.

The system underneath

Every value the app draws with is a token in this block: nine type roles, four weights, three inks, two edges, named control heights, corners, icons, the paper heights and the grain. Nothing outside it uses a raw colour or size.

Buttons are paper at known heights

One family. Hover and press them: the key is the only lifted control, a quiet slip lifts a hair and presses into the page, text is ink on the sheet. Disabled is paper with faded ink.

The desk is sheets laid side by side

On a wide screen the trip's Ideas column becomes a one-sheet stack with the same top edge, lift and peek as the Days stack beside it, instead of a flat card.

Floating things are slips

Menus, toasts and tooltips keep Ant's behaviour but are drawn once as paper at popover height, with the same edge, corners and type. The desk's add bar (the composer) floats higher still, at --lift-bar, with its round key 8px clear of the pill.

A finished run is a slip

DoneSlip is a moment, not a control. When a shopping run ends (the last item checked, or Clear done, mid-run) a paper slip at popover height (--lift-3) rises into the middle of the screen: 16px corners, 320px wide, the title in Outfit 28px with the highlighter swiped under it as a new row's is, a plain line beneath, then what the run got as the list rows' own category tags with counts (Produce ×6, Dairy ×5: the page's colour, spent on meaning), and, when the run beat the house's usual, a dashed tear (as on the invite-code ticket) and one word of praise in --ok-ink. It is flat paper: no fill colour, no tilt, no extra chrome, so the page's one yellow key stays the only yellow. No scrim: the page stays usable and a tap or Esc dismisses it. It rises over --dur-base, the highlighter sweeps in over --dur-slow, it rests about 2.5s and lifts away. Reduced motion only fades. One per run, announced once, and it only ever praises, never scolds.
